home.announcement: Delivery in 1-3 days · Cash on delivery
home.editorialText: Fresh fits for the cold days. Limited quantities, made to stand out.
home.pointsText: Order 100 ₪ or more and get points worth 5 ₪ for every 100 — spend them on your next order.

track.title: Track order
track.intro: Enter the phone number you ordered with to see all your orders and where each one is.
track.notFound: We couldn't find an order with that number and phone.
track.hint_shipped: It's with the courier once shipped
track.noneForPhone: No orders found for this phone number. Check it's the one you used at checkout.
track.fullPhone: Enter the full phone number you ordered with.

points.title: ENZO Points
points.intro: Every order brings you closer to the next one. Collect points and spend them as money off at checkout.
points.signInToCollect: or create an account to start collecting points — guest orders don't earn points.
points.howEarn: Orders of 100 ILS or more earn 500 points for every full 100 ILS (worth 5 ILS). Points land in your account the moment you order.
points.howUse: 100 points = 1 ILS. At checkout, choose how many points to use and they come straight off your items (not delivery).
points.cancel: If an order is cancelled, its points are taken back and any points you spent on it come back to you. Returning items adjusts the points the same way.
points.rateNote: Points are counted on what you pay for items after discounts, without the delivery fee.
points.inStore: Buying in the shop? Tell the seller the phone number on your ENZO account (add it under My account) and the purchase earns points the same way.

tour.welcomeText: Let us show you around — we'll jump between pages and point at exactly where to tap. It takes under a minute.
tour.featuredNewText: {{name}} is our newest piece. Tap any product to see its photos, colors and sizes.
tour.featuredSaleText: {{name}} is discounted right now. Sale prices show in gold, with the old price crossed out.
tour.menuText: The menu opens every category, plus Track order and your ENZO points.
tour.sizesText: In the shop, tap the sizes you wear. The small number shows how many pieces have each size, and "In stock only" hides what's sold out.
tour.colorsText: Choosing a color changes the photo and shows the sizes available in that color.
tour.pickSizeText: Sizes that are sold out in that color are crossed out and can't be picked.
tour.addText: Add it here. Delivery takes 1-3 days and you pay cash on delivery.
tour.cartText: Everything you've added waits here — open it any time to check out.
tour.codeText: Type it here at checkout and the discount comes straight off your items.
tour.pointsText: Every 100 ₪ you spend earns 500 points (5 ₪). Use them here — 100 points = 1 ₪ off.
tour.trackText: Enter the phone number you ordered with to see where each order is: received, confirmed, on the way, delivered.
tour.helpText: Tap WhatsApp on any page to message us about sizes or an order.
